meta.name: bioservices
meta.description: Unified Python interface to 40+ bioinformatics services. Use when querying multiple databases (UniProt, KEGG, ChEMBL, Reactome) in a single workflow with consistent API. Best for cross-database analysis, ID mapping across services. For quick single-database lookups use gget; for sequence/file manipulation use biopython.

copy.tagline: 用统一接口查询40多个生物信息学数据库
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要在多个生物数据库间进行联合查询和ID映射
copy.tagline_en: Query 40+ bioinformatics databases with a unified interface
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to query multiple biological databases and map IDs across them

howto.what: 安装后，Claude可以编写Python代码，通过bioservices库访问40多个生物信息学数据库（如UniProt、KEGG、ChEMBL），执行蛋白质搜索、通路分析、化合物查询、序列比对和ID映射等操作，并返回结构化的数据结果。
howto.when: 当用户需要跨多个生物数据库（如UniProt、KEGG）进行综合查询、标识符映射或复杂分析时触发。更适合需要统一API调用多个服务的场景，而非单一数据库快速查找。

say.text: 通过KEGG查找人体中与B细胞相关的通路
将一组UniProt ID批量映射到KEGG ID

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude can write Python code to access 40+ bioinformatics databases (e.g., UniProt, KEGG, ChEMBL) via the bioservices library, performing protein search, pathway analysis, compound query, sequence alignment, and ID mapping, returning structured results.
howto.when_en: Triggered when the user needs cross-database queries, identifier mapping, or complex analysis across multiple bioinformatics services. Best for unified API access to multiple services, not for quick single-database lookups.

say_en.text: Search UniProt for the protein sequence of ZAP70_HUMAN.
Find pathways related to B cells in human via KEGG.
Batch map a list of UniProt IDs to KEGG IDs.
